name: EXSR
summary: EXSR is a scalping Expert Advisor that executes short-term trades based on rapid price movement signals. It aims to capture small pip gains with quick entries and exits during high-liquidity sessions. The EA appears to use momentum and spread conditions to trigger trades with tight take-profit targets.
summary_zh: EXSR是一个剥头皮型智能交易系统，基于快速价格运动信号执行短线交易。它旨在高流动性时段通过快速进出捕获小额利润。该EA使用动量和点差条件触发交易，并设置紧密的止盈目标。
strategy_analysis: EXSR策略的核心概念是利用短期价格动量进行快速剥头皮交易。入场条件基于价格在短时间内的快速变动信号，通常在高流动性时段触发买入或卖出操作。出场条件采用较紧的止盈设置，以小利润积少成多，同时配合止损控制单笔亏损。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，但未发现动态仓位调整或基于资金比例的计算逻辑。资金管理依赖于止损止盈的比率设置，但缺少对最大持仓数和总体风险的系统性控制。整体策略偏向高频小利模式，对点差和滑点敏感，在低流动性或高波动时段可能表现不佳。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the EXSR strategy is to capitalize on short-term price momentum for rapid scalping trades. Entry conditions are based on fast price movement signals, typically triggering buy or sell operations during high-liquidity sessions. Exit conditions employ tight take-profit settings to accumulate small gains, combined with stop-loss controls to limit individual trade losses. In terms of position sizing, the EA supports fixed lot trading but lacks dynamic position adjustment or equity-proportional calculation logic. Money management relies on stop-loss and take-profit ratio settings, but there is no systematic control over maximum open positions or overall portfolio risk. The overall strategy leans toward a high-frequency small-profit model, which is sensitive to spread and slippage, and may underperform during low-liquidity or high-volatility sessions.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和维护
使用点差过滤避免在高成本环境下交易
快速进出市场，单笔风险时间窗口短
止盈止损设定明确，每笔交易风险可量化
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and maintain
Uses spread filter to avoid trading in high-cost environments
Quick market entries and exits, short risk exposure window per trade
Well-defined stop-loss and take-profit, quantifiable risk per trade
cons: 缺少动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应不同账户规模
未设置最大持仓数限制，极端情况下可能开过多订单
剥头皮策略对点差和滑点极度敏感，实际执行可能与回测偏差大
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lot size cannot adapt to different account sizes
No maximum open position limit; could open excessive orders in extreme conditions
Scalping strategy is extremely sensitive to spread and slippage; actual execution may deviate significantly from backtesting
Missing new bar check mechanism; may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加基于账户余额的动态仓位计算功能，如风险百分比模式
添加最大同时持仓数限制和日内最大亏损限制
增加新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线重复交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance, such as risk percentage mode
Add maximum simultaneous position limit and daily maximum loss limit
Add new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades on the same bar

risk_points: 剥头皮策略对点差和执行质量高度敏感，实盘滑点可能导致亏损
缺少最大持仓限制，连续信号可能导致过度开仓
未检测新K线，可能在同一价格区域重复入场
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy is highly sensitive to spread and execution quality; real-world slippage may cause losses
No maximum position limit; consecutive signals may lead to overexposure
No new bar detection; may repeatedly enter at the same price area
